author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
In a status meeting, my junior engineer gave an update on "we have done XYZ".   I thought he is the only one assigned on that task, so, I asked him who else is working on that task.  He clarified that "we" refer to himself and Claude.

Is it a Gen-Z thing?  I use "I" when I talk about me using AI as a tool.  Gen-Z seems to use "we" as if AI is another person.
